verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own site says that in Bionic, its agent app listed in the LM Studio docs, "your speech gets transcribed in real time" and that voice data "is processed locally and never leaves your device." That covers dictation, real-time transcription and on-device processing. The support rests on homepage marketing copy only. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the transcription model and setup, hands-on or independent confirmation of real-time on-device dictation, and confirmation that dictation works beyond Bionic in the core LM Studio chat.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate speech that gets transcribed in real time by an on-device model

citations.quote: Talk to Bionic naturally, and your speech gets transcribed in real time. Your voice and audio data is processed locally and never leaves your device.
